title: IGI promoter to sell ₹281 cr stake

timeline.title: IGI promoter to sell ₹281 cr stake
timeline.line: BCP Asia II Topco approved selling about 1.6% of IGI through a block deal
more: The sale is to meet minimum public shareholding rules
IGI had been flagged for a possible block deal on Friday

src.title: Market trades lower, IGIL promoter approves selling a Rs 281 crore stake
